en.headline: Chan says ride-hailing data system has entered testing
en.dek: The transport chief said the system is largely complete, as nine autonomous-vehicle pilot licences are already issued.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Thursday that the Transport Department's ride-hailing data-management system is largely complete and has entered testing, to check data security and later dynamic assessment. She said the government has finished the legislation to regulate ride-hailing services.

Chan also said the government will push autonomous driving towards scale and commercial use. The Transport Department has issued nine pilot licences, with tests under way in several districts. She said some projects will this year test vehicles with no backup operator on board, and that the Northern Metropolis should be a suitable proving ground.

On rail, she said Kwu Tung Station is due to be completed next year. The Northern Link Spur Line and the main line will be taken forward together, with a target of opening together in or before 2034. On roads, the government will give priority to the Tsing Lung Bridge at the southern end of Route 11, aiming to open it in 2033, and has brought the San Tin section of the Northern Metropolis Highway forward by two years to 2034.

Chan said current estimates put new public roads in the Northern Metropolis at nearly 170 kilometres, including about 24 kilometres of trunk roads linking development nodes and about 144 kilometres of district roads inside the new development areas. She said a new-generation public-transport interchange at a Northern Metropolis hub will release real-time traffic information for cross-boundary travellers.

zh.headline: 陳美寶：網約車數據系統已進入測試
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長說系統已基本完成，運輸署並已批出九個自動駕駛先導牌照。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶星期四表示，政府已完成規管網約車服務的立法，運輸署的網約車數據管理系統已基本完成，並進入測試階段，以確保數據安全及日後的動態評估。
陳美寶說，政府會推動自動駕駛走向規模化及商業化。運輸署已批出九個先導牌照，並在多區測試；部分項目今年內會進行車內沒有後備操作員的測試。她認為北部都會區會是合適的試驗場。
鐵路方面，她說古洞站將於明年落成。北環綫支綫與主綫會一併推進，目標在2034年或之前同步開通。道路方面，政府會優先推展11號幹線南端的青龍大橋，目標2033年通車，並把北部都會區公路新田段的通車目標提早兩年，至2034年。
按目前估算，北部都會區將新增近170公里公共道路，包括連接各發展重心約24公里的主幹道，以及新發展區內約144公里的地區道路。她又說，會在北都交通樞紐設立新一代公共交通交匯處，發放實時交通資訊，方便跨境出行的市民和遊客。
